note: A long, confident narrative with plenty of operational vocabulary and no trigger or steps.
title: Add search suggestions behind a flag
body:
Adds suggestions behind a flag.

We have thought carefully about operational risk. Observability, resilience and graceful degradation were front of mind throughout. The team has a strong track record of safe releases, a mature on-call culture and excellent rollback tooling, and this change is small, well tested and low risk. Stakeholders across product and engineering have been consulted and are comfortable.
